notes:
Debug-signed dev build for sideloading, with the in-app updater; not for Play.

No backend: the app reads only the public catalog (https://catalog.g3tech.net). Also attached: the Google TV overlay app (sideload it; it does not update itself).

Changes since the last release:

- chore(release): ad-sentinel 0.1.2 (861d0d8)
- g3-ui: frosted surfaces (the translucent Fab, the iOS bottom bar) blur in Android web views again, and NavBar can float as a pill (g3techhq/g3-ui@71d6aab)
- g3-ui: an iOS toolbar segment pill no longer cuts its longest label on a phone, and an expanded AdaptiveNav rail opens to 15rem again (g3techhq/g3-ui@ebcdb7a)
